fields.label: Enable Elemental Day-End Attendance
fields.description: When enabled, Elemental creates daily Attendance and disables HRMS Shift Type auto-attendance. When disabled, remembered Shift Types are restored.

fields.label: Day-End Processing Hour (24-hour)
fields.description: Default 23 means the hourly scheduler processes attendance after 23:00 site time.

fields.label: Require OUT Scan for Present
fields.description: If enabled, an IN without a later OUT is marked Absent for HR review.
